pr_title: Reverse the order of the task queue
pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/5047

## What does this PR do?
- Provide a new parameter to reverse the order of the task queue
- Add tests
- Remove some unrelated tests that were duplicated in tests/tasks/mod.rs and tests/tasks/error.rs

issue_context.title: Provide a `reverse` query parameter while querying tasks
issue_context.body:
Related product team resources: [PRD](https://www.notion.so/meilisearch/Reverse-the-order-of-the-task-queue-1364b06b651f801ca127d982289892e5) (_internal only_)

## Motivation

Often, while debugging, being able to retrieve the oldest task that matches your filter could be useful, currently the only way to do it is to paginate the task queue which is not easy to do by hand, or to retrieve a few thousands tasks which is hard to read and doesn’t guarantee you have the oldest task.

## Usage

https://www.notion.so/meilisearch/Feature-Reverse-the-order-of-the-task-queue-1364b06b651f81dcb618e8409d30429b

## Impacted teams
